**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Small, long-running (since 1995) open-access XR journal covering Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Mixed Reality and adjacent tech. Recent-issue evidence is thin: the only fetchable current-issue content found was a 2025 Laval Virtual Doctoral Consortium Proceedings entry (Vol.1 No.1, 2025), suggesting the journal runs conference-proceedings/special-issue content alongside regular research articles. Homepage teasers referenced educational VR training, VR in physical rehabilitation/mood enhancement, and game-based therapeutic interventions for hospitalized children as recent topics, but exact titles/dates could not be independently confirmed via DBLP (which lists volumes but not article-level titles in the fetch obtained).

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** Experimental/empirical VR-AR-MR studies, Applied/industrial XR case studies, Theoretical/conceptual XR papers, Health & wellness applications (surgery, healthcare training, mental health, phobia treatment), Human factors (presence, embodiment, cognition, ethics, social interaction, avatars, UX, 3D interaction), Design & creativity (engineering design, co-creation, data visualization, immersive storytelling, CAD), Industry 4.0 (manufacturing training, maintenance, design), Emerging tech crossovers (AI integration, IoT, computer graphics, haptics, tracking, robotics, drones, 3D printing)

- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev search returned no dedicated IJVR review page; LetPub shows 0 logged submitter experiences; no forum discussion found on 小木虫/知乎/發表吧/Reddit r/AskAcademia.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand accept/reject narrative found in any cross-language source searched.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: Zero forum or SciRev first-hand accounts located; nothing to characterize reviewer tone/culture without fabricating.
- **positioning.framing_required**: No CFP or editorial framing guidance found beyond generic aims & scope; journal did not surface a current special-issue CFP in search.
